topography.project_purpose: Liquid Staking. Structurally: 252 project-authored contract(s) across 5 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 82 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 8 functional families. Its contracts share 17 common project-authored base contract(s) (multicall, lockable, erc20upgradesafe). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
